title: Atlanta in the Fourth Great Maelstrom
summary: How the great storm struck the Necropolis of Atlanta.

claims.text: During the Fourth Great Maelstrom, longer than most before it, Atlanta's wraiths crowded into the Hierarchy Citadel or hid in Haunts under the viaducts; many were lost to Oblivion and more fell to their Shadows.
Fire-rain fell in sheets and clawing red serpent-things dropped from the sky, leaving scars even Masquers could not mend, while Doppelgangers sang to lone wraiths.
Distrust swept the city afterward; loners and those who avoided Pardoners were suspected first, and some Circles posted a Pardoner at the door of their Haunt.

title: Track 6A
summary: A Haunt beneath Five Points station.

claims.text: While building Atlanta's subway in the late 1970s, MARTA crews failed again and again to blast through one stretch of granite that geologists could find nothing wrong with.
Rather than use enough explosive to wreck the tunnel, engineers routed a short bypass, Track 6A, around the stone beneath Five Points station, and the spot is now a Haunt.
